comment: Content-addressed history for mrson streams: git-style commits + forks + pull requests, enabling read-only sharing with fork-and-contribute. Realtime ops are NOT hashed; a ~1Hz sealer bundles them into content-addressed Commits. See docs/MRSON-COMMITS-FORKS.md (SlicerLive repo).

ContentHash.comment: Content id 'sha256-<hex>' over the CANONICAL serialization (RFC 8785 JCS, or canonical CBOR) of the referent. Same content -> same hash across hosts. Shared with the zarr blob channel.

BranchPoint.comment: An unambiguous point in a stream = a sealed commit + N ops past it (deterministic replay). Gives per-op branch granularity without hashing every op.

offset.comment: ops applied AFTER `commit` (0 = at the commit)

Commit.comment: A ~1Hz content-addressed SEAL over the ops since its parent (a git commit). `hash` is computed over this object with `hash` OMITTED. The delta bundle + parents make the chain capture full ancestry, so state is reproducible by replay without a per-commit snapshot.

hash.comment: this commit's id (content-addressed; excludes the `hash` field itself)

parents.comment: parent commit hashes: 0 = root, 1 = normal, 2+ = merge

base.comment: present on a fork's FIRST commit: the upstream branch point

t.comment: commit time (ISO-8601). The realtime op log keeps relative int ms; a sealed commit uses a durable timestamp.

message.comment: optional; doubles as a LiveStory step/mark label

ops.comment: the sealed delta since the parent (inline for self-containment in v0). AnyOp; tightens to ops.AnyOp in a composed (Import) build, like ops.PutOp.node.

tree.comment: optional git-TREE: content hash of the resulting node-map snapshot (a replay keyframe); enables state dedup across forks

Ref.comment: A named pointer to a commit — a branch/HEAD or a tag.

Stream.comment: An UPSTREAM (canonical) recorded mrson stream = an ordered commit DAG over an op history + content-addressed blobs. Owner holds write; others get read-only.

commits.comment: the sealed commit log (the unsealed realtime tail lives outside content-addressing)

Fork.comment: A BY-REFERENCE delta stream branched from an upstream Stream (a git fork), living in the forker's OWN writable space. References upstream blobs by hash; stores only NEW blobs. By-reference is the default (esp. PHI): revoking upstream read cascades the fork's view to broken, and no PHI is duplicated.

blobBase.comment: the fork's own blob store — NEW blobs only; upstream blobs referenced by hash

PullRequest.comment: A request to merge a Fork's commits (from `base`) into an upstream Stream. The owner replays + accepts/rejects; a merge appends the accepted ops and PROMOTES new blobs, keeping each op's origin (provenance = audit).
